beta_lactam_core.name: Beta-Lactam 4-Membered Azetidin-2-one Ring
beta_lactam_core.description: 4-membered azetidinone lactam ring acting as suicidal acylating inhibitor for PBP transpeptidases

carbapenem_core.name: Carbapenem Pyrroline-Fused Beta-Lactam
carbapenem_core.description: Bicyclic carbapenem core with trans-hydroxyethyl group providing beta-lactamase stability

cephalosporin_core.name: Cephalosporin Dihydrothiazine-Fused Beta-Lactam
cephalosporin_core.description: Fused 4:6 cephem nucleus with delta-3 double bond and leaving group at C3

fluoroquinolone_core.name: 4-Quinolone-3-Carboxylic Acid Core
fluoroquinolone_core.description: 1,4-dihydro-4-oxoquinoline-3-carboxylic acid core chelating Mg2+ in the QRDR pocket

aminoglycoside_core.name: Aminocyclitol 2-Deoxystreptamine Core
aminoglycoside_core.description: Polycationic aminocyclitol ring with basic amino sugars binding 16S A-site rRNA
aminoglycoside_core.vulnerable_bond: Amino / Hydroxyl groups susceptible to AAC/APH/ANT modifying enzymes

tetracycline_core.name: Naphthacene Carboxamide Core
tetracycline_core.description: Fused 4-ring carbocyclic system binding reversibly to 30S ribosomal A-site

oxazolidinone_core.name: 2-Oxazolidone Core Ring
oxazolidinone_core.description: Heterocyclic 5-membered ring fitting into the peptidyl transferase center (PTC)

polymyxin_core.name: Cationic Cyclic Heptapeptide with Fatty Acyl Tail
polymyxin_core.description: Amphipathic polycationic lipopeptide displacing Ca2+/Mg2+ from Lipid A phosphate headgroups

glycopeptide_core.name: Cross-Linked Heptapeptide Aglycone Cage
glycopeptide_core.description: Bulky aromatic heptapeptide cage binding D-Ala-D-Ala terminus of lipid II

rifamycin_core.name: Naphthoquinone Ansa-Macrocycle
rifamycin_core.description: Aromatic naphthoquinone spanned by an aliphatic ansa bridge blocking RNA polymerase elongation

anti_tb_hydrazide_core.name: Isonicotinoyl Hydrazine Core
anti_tb_hydrazide_core.description: Pyridine-4-carbohydrazide prodrug activated by KatG to form an INH-NAD adduct inhibiting InhA

anti_tb_ethambutol_core.name: N,N-Dialkyl-Ethylenediamine Core
anti_tb_ethambutol_core.description: Substituted ethylenediamine inhibiting arabinosyl transferase EmbB involved in arabinogalactan synthesis

macrolide_core.name: Macrocyclic Lactone Ring
macrolide_core.description: 14-16 membered macrocyclic lactone ring reversibly blocking nascent peptide exit tunnel
